fork_shape.modified_files_summary: After re-platforming onto upstream 0.9.0 (React UI migration, ADR-0002) and re-applying the pivi->yapi rebrand, the fork is 9 commits / ~863 files ahead of tag 0.9.0 (20411+/12415-); almost all of it is the mechanical rename (host product only, Pi engine untouched). The non-mechanical divergences are: (a) behavioural UI (header-locked tab bar, theme-aware toolbar icons + brightened brand color, simplified tab-switcher animation); (b) YP brand mark + folder-search icon fix; (c) dropped release-please/GitHub Actions; (d) fork identity/tooling/docs. See scripts/rename-map.json for the structural map and change_categories below for commit mapping.

change_categories.summary: Full structural rename pivi->yapi (host product only; Pi engine @earendil-works/* untouched). Plugin id, package scopes (@pivi/* -> @yapi/*), PascalCase identifiers, .yapi- CSS namespace, .yapi/ vault data dir + YAPI_* constants, authorship, YP brand mark, tagline. Re-applied to the 0.9.0 React tree via scripts/rename-map.json + apply-rename.mjs (map extended: packages/pivi-react -> packages/yapi-react).

Fork identity, rebrand tooling, and docs: LICENSE, README, CONTEXT, AGENTS.md (root + package), CHANGELOG, ADRs (0001-rebrand, 0002-adopt-upstream-react-ui-migration), manifest/package identity, deploy path .obsidian/plugins/yapi, fork-maintenance skills + this profile, scripts/{apply-rename,check-rename,rename-map}. check-rename now also scans file paths (857 paths).
Re-dropped release-please config + GitHub Actions workflows + the tag/release invariant after re-platform. Versioning is manual/local: <yapi-core>-u<upstream> (0.1.0-u0.9.0).
Reconciled to 0.9.0's evolved architecture: check:architecture boundary model (L0 map, ChatPorts, product-owned React UI), esbuild.config.mjs <-> build/ split, 5-gate green, base tag bumped to 0.9.0.

Re-derived on React (Track 2, issues 07-09): header-locked tab bar (removed tabBarPosition setting + all input-mode plumbing), theme-aware toolbar icons + brightened brand color (#0635f9, --yapi-interactive-fg), simplified tab-switcher animation (block-size). Plus YP brand mark ported into React ChatLogo, and folder-search icon replacing the invalid database-search.

known_pitfalls: Upstream changed tag convention at 0.3.0: old releases v0.1.0..v0.2.4 use a 'v' prefix and annotated tags; releases 0.3.x..0.5.0+ are bare numbers (e.g. 0.5.0) as lightweight/unannotated tags. detect-upstream-base MUST use 'git describe --tags --match "[0-9]*"' (--tags for lightweight, [0-9]* to match new releases).

Version scheme is manual and local: <yapi-core>-u<upstream> (e.g. 0.1.0-u0.9.0). No Git tags, no GitHub Releases, no release-please. The old Obsidian release invariant (tag equals manifest version) NO LONGER applies. The -u<upstream> suffix mirrors profile.versioning.current_base_tag; auto-cherry-pick bumps both on sync.

Rebrand divergence: upstream uses pivi/Pivi/PIVI and @pivi/* everywhere; this fork uses yapi/Yapi/YAPI and @yapi/*. Raw `git rebase --onto` cannot follow the renames. Cherry-pick upstream commits one at a time and consult scripts/rename-map.json to translate upstream pivi paths/identifiers into fork yapi/Yapi names before applying. The Pi engine layer (engine/pi, @earendil-works/pi-*) is shared and must NOT be renamed.
main.js bundle is ~2.96MB; watch for size growth after Pi/provider dependency changes via `npm run analyze:bundle`.

Jest invocation: AGENTS.md mandates running through `npm run test` (scripts/run-jest.js adds --localstorage-file). Use `npm run test -- {path}` for single files. Verified 2026-07-14: the full suite is 217 suites / 1576 tests; run via the wrapper to match the `npm run test:coverage` verification gate.

Sync strategy is cherry-pick for incremental upstream releases (0.9.x -> 0.10.x), but a structural upstream change (e.g. another UI-framework migration like the 0.7.0->0.9.0 React migration) breaks cherry-pick/rebase because it touches the renamed surface wholesale. In that case re-platform instead (ADR-0002 precedent: re-apply the rebrand via apply-rename.mjs onto the new upstream tag, then re-derive the behavioural customizations). detect-upstream-base finds the base; auto-cherry-pick only suits non-structural deltas.
